gaps.reason: The emitted iOS output does not provide the authored Light / Dark / System preference control.
gaps.consequence: These native clients and their embedded Rails responses follow system appearance. The browser selector and saved browser preference do not change the native clients.

gaps.reason: The Plan sets no application.domain, so the iOS Release build uses the placeholder origin https://northside-readers.invalid and the placeholder bundle ID invalid.firstdraft.northside-readers.
gaps.consequence: The Release build points at these placeholders, so it cannot reach a server or be submitted to the App Store. Set application.domain, or replace both values, before a Release build; the bundle ID cannot change after the app is published.
